verdict.rationale: Amplitude AI lets users 'ask questions in plain language' and get answers across data (docs-10, docs-34), and the MCP server exposes this natural-language Q&A to external AI tools (docs-11/17). However, the evidence shows only query/answer capability, not natural-language commands that perform actions like building cohorts, launching experiments, or changing flags. Missing for 10: evidence of NL-driven task execution/actions within Amplitude itself, and independent hands-on confirmation of the AI assistant's reliability.
